info.title: Tazweed Phase09 delivery, independent cash and commissions, quality
info.description: PostgreSQL transactions and scoped authorization. Commission before discount frozen at dispatch and earned once at delivery. Cash is explicitly recorded. Original allocations and reversal credits are retained. Real providers and devices await the owner.
